_about: Coordinator's developer-aware, contract-faithful predictions for all 73 public dev-v1.1 cases, frozen BEFORE any Opus 5.5 response (story #159). For each case: cf = the decision a model following contract v3 / prompt v7 exactly should reach from the evidence the harness delivers (class, action); alt = other contract-defensible decisions where the contract or a hand judgement leaves it open; status = established | ambiguous | exploration (the cf needs the listed calls); explore = the calls; why = the basis. Never a model or harness input. Labels and supported actions come from the public case JSON; label_pass is computed by scripts/validity_ceiling.py with the unchanged score.py rules, never written here.
